- `.storybook/preview.tsx` supplies an `IntlProvider` for stories

**Pay particular attention to "a strictly narrower subtree."** Is that actually right? Work out the real nesting of `_app-config` versus base `_app` and say whether the characterisation holds. If it doesn't, that's a new false claim replacing an old one.

The text claims "only `header.ts`/`listMenu.ts`/`navConstants.ts` still live in `theme/components/` itself" — verify by listing the directory and reading `theme/components/index.ts`.

## 4 — `overrides/app/components/header/index.tsx` (2 comments)

Both comments were rescoped. They now claim:
- Account is present as text **at `lg`+** via the "Desktop right" block
- **Below `lg`** the header renders Search / Store Locator / Bag only
- Account is reached below `lg` through the burger drawer — specifically base `drawer-menu`'s "My Account" / "Sign in"
- HPC-025 confirms mobile chrome deliberately surfaces controls in the drawer rather than mirroring desktop

Verify every one against the actual JSX breakpoints in that file, the base `drawer-menu` source in `node_modules/@salesforce/retail-react-app/`, and `.docs/prd/homepage.md` for HPC-018 and HPC-025. **Check HPC-025 actually says what's claimed** — quote it. If the citation is wrong or the PRD doesn't support it, that matters more than anything else in this review, because it's a citation added specifically to justify declining a finding.

Verified all four. Two false claims found.

## FALSE

**Item 4 — the HPC-025 citation is wrong.** This is the worst finding, since it was added specifically to justify declining a finding.

HPC-025 appears exactly twice in all of `.docs/` (`grep -rn "HPC-025" .docs/`), both in `/Users/marcel.a.n.navarro/Dev/zimmermann-pwa/.docs/prd/homepage.md`, both under **§2 Navigation**:

- `:23` — "On mobile it is additionally surfaced within the **hamburger/burger menu** (HPC-025, confirmed)" — subject of the sentence is the **country/region selector**.
- `:38` — "**Mobile**: hamburger menu (HPC-025, confirmed). The country/region selector is also surfaced within the mobile hamburger/burger menu (HPC-025, confirmed — placement detail)."

HPC-025 confirms only (a) mobile navigation is a hamburger menu and (b) the **region selector** lives in it. It says nothing about Account, and there is no requirement anywhere stating "mobile chrome surfaces controls in the drawer rather than mirroring desktop" — that generalisation is invented from a single region-selector placement note. The comment's claim that "HPC-025 confirms [Account in the drawer] is deliberate" is unsupported.

It also cuts against the requirement it's placed next to. `homepage.md:19`: "The confirmed header icon set is: **Search, Account, and Bag** (HPC-018)." No breakpoint qualification exists in HPC-018, so "Account is present as text at `lg`+" does not satisfy it below `lg` on the PRD's own terms — the comment asserts compliance where the doc is silent.

**Item 2 — "only `header.ts`/`listMenu.ts`/`navConstants.ts` still live in `theme/components/` itself" is false.** `ls /Users/marcel.a.n.navarro/Dev/zimmermann-pwa/overrides/app/theme/components/` returns `footerShared.ts`, `header.ts`, `index.ts`, `listMenu.ts`, `navConstants.ts`, `recipeGuards.test.ts`. **`footerShared.ts` is missing from the "only" list** — and it is exactly the kind of file being enumerated: `.claude/rules/overrideStyling.md` and `protectedFiles.md` both single it out as the file deliberately kept in `theme/components/` for cross-file shared values. (`index.ts` is fairly excluded by context; `recipeGuards.test.ts` is a test.)

Registration split, for the record: `theme/components/index.ts` registers 12 recipes — 10 co-located (`Button`, `ZimmFooter`, `ZimmFooterNavColumn`, `ZimmFooterBottomBar`, `ZimmModal`, `ZimmSubscribeModal`, `ZimmSubscribeSection`, `ZimmContactIconRow`, `ZimmNavItem`, `ZimmTextInput`), 2 centralized (`Header`, `ListMenu` via `./header`, `./listMenu`). `navConstants.ts` and `footerShared.ts` are not registered recipes.

## OVERSTATED

**Item 2 — "each with a co-located `<name>.css.ts` recipe."** Three ui-kits components in the footer's own decomposition have no recipe: `zimmIcon/`, `zimmLogo/`, `zimmInputAction/` (only `index.tsx` + `index.stories.tsx`). All three are used on the footer path (`footer/index.tsx:3` imports `ZimmLogo`; `footer/bottomBar/index.tsx:3` imports `ZimmIcon`; `zimmSubscribeSection/index.tsx:3` imports `ZimmInputAction`). "each" is literally wrong; 7 of 10 ui-kits dirs have one.

**Item 2 — "`en-CA` is not provisioned in the Contentful space": UNVERIFIABLE from the repo.** Confirming it requires a live Contentful call, which is out of bounds. Local evidence is neutral: `en-CA` appears in `overrides/app/config/contentfulMapping.generated.ts:11` as a *SFCC*-sourced supported locale, and in `scripts/contentful/setup/seedRegions.mjs` only as a `region` entry **field value**, never as a space locale (that script writes every field under `DEFAULT_LOCALE = 'en'`). Nothing in-repo confirms or refutes the space config.

## ACCURATE

**Item 1 — all five claims hold, including "a strictly narrower subtree."**

- `useUiCopy`: `overrides/app/hooks/useUiCopy.ts` last line is verbatim `export const useUiCopy = (): UiCopyContextValue => useContext(UiCopyContext) ?? FALLBACK_ONLY;`.
- `useIntl` throws: `node_modules/react-intl/lib/src/components/useIntl.js` calls `invariantIntlContext(intl)`; `node_modules/react-intl/lib/src/utils.js:6` — `invariant(intl, '[React Intl] Could not find required \`intl\` object. ' + '<IntlProvider> needs to exist in the component ancestry.')`, and `@formatjs/ecma402-abstract/lib/utils.js:82-84` does `throw new Err(message)` unconditionally (not dev-gated). react-intl 5.25.1.
- Provider location: `IntlProvider` is at `node_modules/@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/components/_app/index.jsx:326`; there is **no** `overrides/app/components/_app/`, so the base file is live. `overrides/app/components/_app-config/index.tsx` contains no `IntlProvider` — it mounts `UiCopyProvider` around `{children}`.
- **"Strictly narrower" is correct.** Both render paths nest AppConfig outermost: `ssr/browser/main.js:67-73` and `ssr/server/react-rendering.js:317-321` both render `createElement(AppConfig, {locals}, createElement(Switch, {App: ...}))`. `switch/index.js` then renders `AppErrorBoundary > !error && App(_app) > Routes`. So `_app-config` ⊃ Switch ⊃ `_app` ⊃ `IntlProvider`. The error-boundary branch strengthens it: when `error` is truthy `_app` never mounts, so `UiCopyProvider` is present and `IntlProvider` is not.
- `.storybook/preview.tsx:4,27-31` — `import { IntlProvider } from 'react-intl'` and a `withIntl` decorator with `locale="en-AU"`. `vitest.setup.ts` is only `import '@testing-library/jest-dom';` — no global Intl wrapper, so "any Vitest test must wrap it too" is right.
- Removed text ("mounted once at the app root (`_app-config`) … degrade gracefully with no Provider present (fallback text, not a throw)") was indeed false on both counts for `useIntl`.

**Item 3 — both claims hold.** `scripts/contentful/setup/seedRegions.mjs` hard-requires it: `const TARGET = getArg('--target'); if (!TARGET) { log.error('--target <environmentId> is required.'); … process.exit(1); }`. `package.json:71` maps `seed:contentful-regions` to that file. `README.md:126` has 4 pipes = 3 columns, matching the header at `:120` — well-formed.

**Item 2 — everything else checks out.** `Last updated: 2026-08-24`; the 2026-08-18 entry survives twice (the `Previous:` clause and the "Token architecture hardened (2026-08-18)" bullet). Zero `button.ts` references remain (case-insensitive grep, exit 1); every replacement path exists (`ui-kits/atoms/zimmButton/zimmButton.css.ts`, `theme/components/index.ts`, `utils/resolveByRegion.ts`, `scripts/auditTokenUsage.mjs` + `audit:tokens` at `package.json:74`). Footer decomposition into `footer/` + `ui-kits/{atoms,molecules,organisms}/` confirmed. `FooterContainer` (`overrides/app/components/footer/index.tsx`) fetches client-side in a `useEffect` via `client.getEntries({content_type: 'footerConfig', include: 3})`, imports `filterByRegion`/`pickMostSpecificByRegion` from `app/utils/resolveByRegion`, has no `getProps`, and `if (!footerData) return null` — so **footer genuinely absent from SSR HTML** is correct. **No locale passed** is correct across the board: no `locale` in the `getEntries` call, none in `useContentfulClient.ts`'s `createClient({space, environment, accessToken, host})`, and no `&locale=` in `useContentful.ts`'s hand-built URLs (`:47`, `:110`). `uiCopy` content type exists (`scripts/contentful/content-types/uiCopy.js`, `key`/`value` with `value` localized) and `UiCopyProvider` is mounted in `_app-config`.

**Item 4 — the non-citation mechanics are all correct.** `overrides/app/components/header/index.tsx`: hamburger `display={{base:'flex', lg:'none'}}` (:225); desktop-left nav+search `{base:'none', lg:'flex'}` (:231); desktop-right Account|Saved|Bag text `{base:'none', lg:'flex'}` (:245); mobile cluster `{base:'flex', lg:'none'}` (:363) containing Search, the commented-out Account/Wishlist block, Store Locator, Bag. Drawer path is real: base `_app/index.jsx:407` passes `onMenuClick={onOpen}` and `:416` renders `<DrawerMenu>`; `drawer-menu/drawer-menu.jsx:235-236` has `'My Account'` (registered) and `:288` `'Sign In'` (guest — the comment writes "Sign in").

Two caveats on that block, both minor: Store Locator is conditional on `storeLocatorEnabled`, so "renders Search / Store Locator / Bag" is only true when that flag is on; and the Store Locator remark is **understated**, not overstated — HPC-018 doesn't merely omit it, `homepage.md:19` explicitly says "Locate Boutique, Contact Us, and Newsletter are **not part of the header**". Net effect below `lg`: the header ships a control the PRD explicitly excludes while dropping one it explicitly requires.

Unrelated aside: `overrides/app/components/button/` still exists (`index.tsx`, `index.stories.tsx`) alongside `ui-kits/atoms/zimmButton/` — not covered by any claim under review, but a likely source of confusion given the `button.ts` → `zimmButton.css.ts` renames.
